lead.headline: COP31 COLLAPSES: NO DEAL AS EU REJECTS FINAL DRAFT
lead.summary: UN climate talks in Antalya break down on Sunday with no agreement after the EU, Panama and the Marshall Islands reject a fourth draft that leaves out fossil fuels. President Murat Kurum says no new draft will be produced, ending the longest climate summit on record.

stories.headline: Bahrain: two hurt in Iran strikes; Gulf condemns
stories.summary: Bahrain says Saturday's Iranian attack on an industrial site in Sitra injured two people, one critically; Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Qatar condemn Iran.

stories.headline: Tanker attacks continue near Hormuz
stories.summary: At least three tankers were reported struck in or near the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday; shipping slows and Iran says the strait will stay closed.

stories.headline: Trump defers new Iran strikes to next year
stories.summary: Donald Trump has deferred any decision on renewed strikes against Iran until after the New Year, U.S. officials say on 22 Nov.

stories.headline: Fighting widens in Yemen's Lahij and Taiz
stories.summary: Fighting breaks out in Yemen's Lahij and Taiz governorates on 22 Nov as airstrikes target Houthi military capabilities.

stories.headline: Gaza: four killed, aid vehicle struck
stories.summary: Gaza's civil defence says four people are killed on 22 Nov, three in a drone strike on a food vehicle in Gaza City.

stories.headline: Russian drone collapses Kyiv apartment block
stories.summary: A Russian drone strikes a five-storey residential building in Dymer, Kyiv region, on Sunday; part collapses and at least 14 people are missing.

stories.headline: Russia fired 2,700 drones this week: Kyiv
stories.summary: President Zelenskyy says Russia launched about 2,700 drones, 1,460 glide bombs and 165 missiles at 20 regions this week.

stories.headline: Russian cargo ship still burning off Finland
stories.summary: A fire aboard a Russian cargo ship struck by drones in the Baltic Sea keeps burning through the night, Finland's coast guard says on Sunday.

stories.headline: Warsaw asks NATO for more surveillance
stories.summary: Poland asks NATO for more surveillance ahead of a North Atlantic Council meeting on Monday after Russian missiles entered its airspace.

stories.headline: Spain heads to 29 November election
stories.summary: Spain votes on 29 November; campaigning enters its final week on 22 Nov.

stories.headline: Factory fire in Indonesia: dozens missing
stories.summary: A fire at a candy factory in Cikande, western Java, leaves three dead and about 36 workers missing on 22 Nov.

stories.headline: Peru quake cracks adobe in Sacred Valley
stories.summary: A magnitude 6.7 earthquake in Peru cracks adobe buildings in the Sacred Valley and prompts emergency response, reported on 22 Nov.

stories.headline: BepiColombo enters orbit around Mercury
stories.summary: The joint ESA-JAXA BepiColombo spacecraft enters orbit around Mercury on 22 Nov after an eight-year journey.

stories.headline: Xi bolsters position after Shenzhen summit
stories.summary: China's Xi Jinping emerges strengthened from the trilateral summit with Trump and Putin in Shenzhen, analysts say on 22 Nov.

stories.headline: Malaysia presses Myanmar ruling with OIC
stories.summary: Malaysia plans to work with the OIC and ASEAN on the world court's ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya.

stories.headline: Boat carrying mourners sinks in Nigeria
stories.summary: A wooden boat ferrying mourners sinks in Nigeria, killing at least 24 people; rescue operations are under way, reported on 22 Nov.

stories.headline: 700,000 displaced in southern Ethiopia
stories.summary: About 700,000 people are displaced in southern Ethiopia as troops mobilise on the Eritrea border, officials say on 22 Nov.

stories.headline: Tributes for Mlambo-Ngcuka, dead at 71
stories.summary: The UN chief and the African Union pay tribute to Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, South Africa's first woman deputy president, who died on 21 Nov.

stories.headline: Morocco sends officers to Gaza force
stories.summary: Morocco has sent army officers to the international force for Gaza, officials confirm on 22 Nov.

stories.headline: Mexico: 11 dead in cartel boss capture
stories.summary: Authorities confirm 11 people died after forces captured alleged Sinaloa cartel leader Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, including four soldiers.

stories.headline: U.S. stocks fall 3.7% in AI sell-off
stories.summary: The S&P 500 falls 3.7% to 6,910 points on 22 Nov, down 9.8% over the past month, in a sharp global sell-off.

stories.headline: FBI probes hack attempt on police database
stories.summary: Cybersecurity officials report a hack attempt on the FBI's National Crime Information Center database, reported on 22 Nov.

stories.headline: Florida flooding lingers; king tides loom
stories.summary: Flooding from days of heavy rain lingers in Florida, and forecasters say king tides could set records on the California coast this week.

stories.headline: U.S. air traffic control overhaul proposed
stories.summary: Transportation officials propose a major overhaul of U.S. air traffic control amid congestion, reported on 22 Nov.

stories.headline: COP31 becomes longest summit on record
stories.summary: The Antalya talks, due to end on Friday, run longer than any previous COP before collapsing on Sunday with no adopted decision.

stories.headline: Kurum: no new draft will be produced
stories.summary: COP31 President Murat Kurum tells the closing plenary on 22 Nov that there will be no new draft of the final text.

stories.headline: Marshall Islands join EU rejection
stories.summary: The Marshall Islands, Norway, Panama and Vanuatu join the EU in rejecting the draft as too weak to advance the fight against global warming.

stories.headline: Finance row at heart of COP31 collapse
stories.summary: Countries split over the pace of the clean-energy transition, the role of carbon capture and support for developing nations.

stories.headline: EU: 'good deal or no deal'
stories.summary: The EU's top climate official says the summit will produce a good deal or no deal at all as talks stretch into overtime.

stories.headline: Whale genome captured from breath
stories.summary: Scientists capture a whale's genome from its breath using a drone, researchers report on 22 Nov.

stories.headline: Formula 1 to return to V8 engines in 2030
stories.summary: Formula 1 will return to V8 engines from 2030, organisers confirm.

stories.headline: Deep Purple postpone world tour
stories.summary: Deep Purple postpone the rest of their 2026 world tour over health problems of singer Ian Gillan, 81.

stories.headline: Sacramento win USL title on penalties
stories.summary: Sacramento Republic beat Louisville on penalties to win the USL Championship.

stories.headline: Santa Fe beat Detroit City for title
stories.summary: Club Atletico Independiente Santa Fe beat Detroit City FC to claim a title on 22 Nov.
